data.one_liner: Translation and localization for Flutter using Dart extensions to reduce boilerplate.
data.what_it_does: Enables text internationalization in Flutter apps using Dart extensions on strings or identifiers. Supports plurals, genders, parameter interpolation, and locale management via code definitions, files, or HTTP.
use_when: You want a localization setup without code generation steps.
You prefer using source strings directly as translation keys.
You need support for complex rules like pluralization and gender variants.
avoid_when: Your project standardizes on standard arb/intl workflows or another localization ecosystem.
You require strictly compile-time type-safe keys via code generation.
strengths: Supports both string keys and traditional identifiers.
Built-in support for pluralization, gender, and interpolation.
weaknesses: Not code-generated, which means keys are not checked statically at compile-time.
License is unknown based on package metadata.
data.setup_notes: Wrap your widget tree with a single I18n widget, provide supported locales, and configure MaterialApp delegates and locale fields.
